name: NIH Documents: Biosketch, Current and Pending (Other) Support, and Malign Foreign Talent Recruitment Program (MFTRP) Certification
intro_text: Each year, the Center collects the Current and Pending (Other) Support of each Core Director, Research Project Leader, and Pilot Project Leader for its Research Performance Progress Report (RPPR) to NIH. If you’re named on the Notice of Award, NIH also needs your biosketch and a Malign Foreign Talent Recruitment Program (MFTRP) certification. Please make each document in SciENcv with NIH’s Common Forms, and upload the certified PDFs here.

about: Each year the Center reviews the Current and Pending (Other) Support of its Core Directors, Research Project Leaders, Pilot Project Leaders, and Program Director/Principal Investigator (PD/PI).
People named on the Notice of Award also give a biosketch and a Malign Foreign Talent Recruitment Program (MFTRP) certification for the Research Performance Progress Report (RPPR).

intro_by.osc: Each year, the Center collects a biosketch from each Other Significant Contributor for its Research Performance Progress Report (RPPR) to NIH. Please make yours in SciENcv with NIH’s Common Form, and upload the certified PDF here.
intro_by.senior_key: Each year, the Center collects three documents from people named on the Notice of Award for its Research Performance Progress Report (RPPR) to NIH. The three documents are your Current and Pending (Other) Support, your biosketch, and a Malign Foreign Talent Recruitment Program (MFTRP) certification. Please make the Current and Pending (Other) Support and the biosketch in SciENcv with NIH’s Common Forms, and upload the certified PDFs here.
intro_by.default: Each year, the Center collects the Current and Pending (Other) Support of each Core Director, Research Project Leader, and Pilot Project Leader for its Research Performance Progress Report (RPPR) to NIH. This form has one effort question and one upload: your certified Current and Pending (Other) Support from SciENcv.

questions.prompt: Will your CNAP effort drop by 25% or more in the next budget year, starting June 1?
questions.help_text: NIH treats a Yes as a request for prior approval. If the drop has already happened, please tell the evaluator, because a separate request is needed.

verbatim.label: Read NIH’s exact wording (RPPR question D.2.a)
verbatim.text: Will there be, in the next budget period, either (1) a reduction of 25% or more in the level of effort from what was approved by the agency for the PD/PI(s) or other senior/key personnel designated in the Notice of Award, or (2) a reduction in the level of effort below the minimum amount of effort required by the Notice of Award?

questions.prompt: Please describe the change in your effort. Please include your current and planned calendar months and when the change starts.

sections.title: Current and Pending (Other) Support
sections.instructions:
Please follow these three steps:
- Please build your Current and Pending (Other) Support in SciENcv with NIH’s Common Form.
- Please certify your Current and Pending (Other) Support in SciENcv, then download the certified PDF.
- Please upload the certified PDF below.
> Please don’t flatten the PDF: NIH checks the SciENcv certification, and flattening removes the certification.
> Your ORCID iD: Your ORCID iD must show in the Persistent Identifier (PID) section.
> Need help with SciENcv: If you need help with SciENcv, please contact your Central Office grant specialist. Unsure who your Central Office grant specialist is? Start with Morgan Wills at mkwills@ksu.edu. Morgan can point you in the right direction.

questions.prompt: Your certified Current and Pending (Other) Support (PDF from SciENcv)

sections.title: Biosketch
sections.instructions:
Because you are listed on CNAP’s Notice of Award (NoA) as Key Personnel, NIH requires your updated biosketch.

Please follow these three steps:
- Please build your biosketch in SciENcv with NIH’s Biographical Sketch Common Form and the NIH Biographical Sketch Supplement, combined in one PDF.
- Please certify your biosketch in SciENcv, then download the certified PDF.
- Please upload the certified PDF below.
> Please don’t flatten the PDF: NIH checks the SciENcv certification, and flattening removes the certification.
> Need help with SciENcv: If you need help with SciENcv, please contact your Central Office grant specialist. Unsure who your Central Office grant specialist is? Start with Morgan Wills at mkwills@ksu.edu. Morgan can point you in the right direction.

questions.prompt: Your certified biosketch, with the NIH Supplement (PDF from SciENcv)

sections.title: Malign Foreign Talent Recruitment Program (MFTRP) certification
sections.instructions:
Every year, NIH requires each senior/key person to certify in the Research Performance Progress Report (RPPR) whether the senior/key person is a party to a Malign Foreign Talent Recruitment Program (MFTRP).

Please follow these four steps:
- Please download your form below. Your name is already filled in.
- Please sign the form with an Adobe digital signature. The guide below walks you through the signature.
- Please flatten the signed form, as NIH asks. Print the form to PDF (Microsoft Print to PDF on Windows, or Save as PDF on a Mac).
- Please upload the flattened PDF here.

sections.title: Foreign-activity documents (only if you have any)

questions.prompt: Contracts for foreign appointments, or for employment with a foreign institution (optional, one flattened PDF)
questions.help_text: NIH takes these contracts as a separate attachment, not inside your Current and Pending (Other) Support. Please leave this upload blank if you have no foreign appointments or foreign employment.

_source: MW 2026-11-04: Core Directors, RPLs, and PPLs only (plus the PD/PI); they report the people on their teams in the progress reports. MW 2026-10-27: PPLs, RPLs, core directors and the CNAP Director upload SciENcv biosketch and Current and Pending once a year; MFTRP certification and D.2.a in the same task; optional foreign-activity documents. Piestar thread (Apr 2026) for D.2 and MFTRP. SciENcv Common Forms required for RPPRs from Jan 25, 2026 (Stanford ORA notice). Wording per NOT-OD-26-018 (Common Forms; NIH Biosketch Supplement; don't flatten SciENcv PDFs; annual MFTRP certification in RPPR G.1 as a flattened PDF named MFTRPcert_[Name].pdf; supporting documentation as a separate flattened attachment) and NOT-OD-26-033 (enforced from May 8, 2026). MW 2026-10-27: Current and Pending from everyone on the list; biosketch and MFTRP only from people named on the Notice of Award (Person.senior_key, default PD/PI and RP Leaders), via a hidden site-set question. MW 2026-11-02: Other Significant Contributors get the task with the biosketch only.
